<a id="public-data-boundary-of-naming-and-target-gaze--命名与所指注视的公开数据边界"></a>
# Public-data boundary of naming and target gaze

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`naming-attention-coverage` · **reviewed-scoped** · assessment · F09 · [record](naming-attention-coverage.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Among 1,508 public naming records from 36 infants, 467 nominal three-second windows contain other-object gaze with zero target gaze; 35 infants show such cases. This limits automatic naming-to-target-gaze measurement correspondence.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Use the deposited fractions and windows with every record retained. Gaze is a limited access proxy, not full optical visibility, represented candidates or learning outcomes.
- Exploratory reanalysis with the paper’s conclusion already known. Seven windows repeatedly measure the same events; participant means are separate, without independent-event inference.
- No renormalization to target-plus-other gaze; zero coded-object gaze, shortened windows and decimal rounding differences remain.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- It does not identify mislearning.
- It does not identify a unique algorithm or the developmental causation of coordination.
- It does not identify consciousness or evolutionary psychology.
- **Counterexample:** At five seconds, 393 windows still contain other gaze with zero target gaze. A separate 45 three-second windows have zero on both and cannot be counted as observed wrong reference. Publication/export binning and count correspondence remains unresolved. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/inquiry-correspondence/naming-attention/README.md)

<a id="progress--已接通"></a>
## Progress

1. What the boundary requires: cooperative naming is not disproved; the measurement correspondence that every naming includes target gaze is limited. Next: coordination cues → encounter admission/weighting → retained reference and correction. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ACQUIRED-SEGMENTATION-INTEGRATION.md#18-review-what-the-measured-boundary-requires-next)
2. Later retention: a public dataset with a later recognition measure adds an empirical constraint (encounter-control-and-retention), leaving this claim, proof and failures unchanged; next is evidence use after experienced reliability changes. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ACQUIRED-SEGMENTATION-INTEGRATION.md#20-counterreview-the-higher-order-relation-that-remains-to-identify)
3. Source reinterpretation: acquired source relations generate binding alternatives for old naming records through an additional route; a historical-applicability counterexample sharpens the next connection. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ACQUIRED-SEGMENTATION-INTEGRATION.md#23-substantive-review-and-the-next-unresolved-connection)
4. Historical applicability: its composition and counterreview turn the continuation toward empirical identification of source–time retention and persistence assumptions. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ACQUIRED-SEGMENTATION-INTEGRATION.md#26-counterreview-and-the-next-discriminating-burden)
5. Five primary sources: formation, retention and use are distinguished; primary evidence constrains automatic transfer without identifying a unique mechanism or evolutionary history. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ACQUIRED-SEGMENTATION-INTEGRATION.md#29-revised-connection-counterreview-and-discriminating-observations)

<a id="evidence--证据"></a>
## Evidence

Eight original files match OSF hashes. An independent Decimal calculation verifies eight count categories and participant statistics across seven windows. Substantive author counterreview completed; no new experiment, independent-agent acceptance or new Lean theorem. Not an exact replication of all published analyses.

Canonical source: [README.md](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/inquiry-correspondence/naming-attention/README.md)

<a id="next--下一步"></a>
## Next

Building on the preserved conditional connections, identify how formed access and retained source/order information guide actual use in a matched developmental procedure, distinguishing present reliance from old-content endorsement.

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The intended target is observer-coded and cannot be assumed as the learner’s known answer. Naming, orientation and object positions are relations within one interaction; these fields do not measure retention or correction.
